title: Work-tape head movement bound
statement: Let $M$ be a multi-tape Turing machine, $c$ a configuration, and $i$ one of its work-tape indices. After one step of $M$ from $c$, the absolute difference between the position of work-tape head $i$ and its position in $c$ is at most $1$.
replaced:
Let $M$ be a multi-tape Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, $c$ a
configuration, and $i$ one of the $k$ work-tape indices.  Then the position of
the $i$-th work-tape head after one step of $M$ from $c$ differs from its
position in $c$ by at most $1$ in absolute value.
